accounting_limits: Cells are exact logical committed source area including fixed; not measured touches, FFT operations, or a runtime prediction.
Native FUNCTION inversion chunks use4096 rows: model256 per family before and144/192/192 after; not hardware inversion profiling.

BINARY builds a65536-entry AND inverse dictionary per instance; ALU repeats its native difference inverse cache and range-dictionary validation; SHIFT repeats shared-dictionary validation/count dot. These are additional instance costs.
Extra components add prefix/mask/Merkle opening costs. OODS273 and proof+76240B are measured from actual wire.
Timings and maxRSS are separate-process observations during concurrent engineering, not uncontended matched speedup evidence. Darwin memory footprint is separately named, never substituted for RSS.
Both are complete accepting genesis-prefix physical proofs; global_chain_accepted=false and no completed-block claim.

compatibility: One canonical schema4/bundle4 replaces3; schema3 physical proof bytes intentionally incompatible. Same-schema owned/borrowed custody remains byte exact. No runtime profile enum or default tail planner switch.
